description: Renovate for Ocimio: Gradle version catalog, Swift packages, GitHub Actions and the Gradle wrapper. Weekly; Kotlin toolchain updates stay manual.

packageRules.description: Major updates are opened only after approval from the Dependency Dashboard.

Kotlin (compiler, Gradle plugins, Compose compiler, serialization plugin, kotlin-test), SKIE, KSP and Mokkery are tied to one exact Kotlin version: one grouped PR, never automatic. Approve it from the Dependency Dashboard once SKIE supports the new Kotlin version.
prBodyNotes: Kotlin, SKIE and KSP must move together. Before merging: check the SKIE compatibility table for this exact Kotlin version, then run the `ios` CI job (Kotlin/Native tests + Xcode build).

packageRules.description: Android Gradle Plugin (application + KMP library plugins share the `agp` version).
GitHub Actions: one grouped PR for non-major updates.
